content.json: ## Area 1 — Cost — *from `azure_cost_snapshot`/`azure_cost_slice`, mirrored by `scripts/sweep_azure_cost.py`, not on a schedule yet*

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name == "azure_cost_snapshot"
| extend d = parse_json(Properties)
| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc
| project month_to_date_spend = todouble(d.month_to_date_total),
          budget_amount = todouble(d.budget_amount),
          month_end_forecast = todouble(d.budget_forecast_spend),
          currency = tostring(d.currency)
| extend spend_pct = iff(budget_amount > 0, round(100.0 * month_to_date_spend / budget_amount, 1), real(null)),
         forecast_pct = iff(budget_amount > 0, round(100.0 * month_end_forecast / budget_amount, 1), real(null))
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", "Month-to-date spend", "Value", spend_pct, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(month_to_date_spend, 1)), " of ", currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)), " budget")),
    pack("Metric", "Budget", "Value", -1.0, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)))),
    pack("Metric", "Month-end forecast", "Value", forecast_pct, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(month_end_forecast, 1)), " projected vs. ", currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)), " budget"))
  )
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = todouble(Metrics.Value), Detail = tostring(Metrics.Detail)
content.title: Month-to-date spend vs. budget vs. forecast (INR) — Value is % of budget, actual amounts in Detail

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name == "azure_cost_slice"
| extend d = parse_json(Properties)
| where tostring(d.dimension) == "ServiceName"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, amount = todouble(d.amount)) by service = tostring(d.dimension_value)
| project Metric = service, Value = strcat("INR ", tostring(round(amount, 1)))
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Spend by Azure service (latest snapshot)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResourceId has "MICROSOFT.APP/CONTAINERAPPS"
| where MetricName in ("CpuPercentage", "MemoryPercentage")
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by App = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])), MetricName
| project Metric = strcat(App, " — ", MetricName), Value
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Current CPU% / memory% (last 1h average, per container app)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResourceId has "MICROSOFT.APP/CONTAINERAPPS"
| where MetricName == "Replicas"
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by App = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1]))
| project Metric = strcat(App, " — Replicas"), Value
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Current replica count (last 1h average, per container app) — no status color, not compared against configured max here

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.app/containerapps" and resourceGroup =~ "rg-invoice-llm-dev"
| project Metric = tolower(tostring(name)), Value = tostring(properties.runningStatus)
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Running status (per container app)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResourceId has "MICROSOFT.APP/CONTAINERAPPS"
| where MetricName == "RestartCount"
| summarize Restarts24h = sum(Total) by App = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1]))
| where Restarts24h > 0
| order by Restarts24h desc
content.title: Restart count, last 24h (0 rows = 0 restarts, a real zero)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("cpu_percent", "memory_percent", "storage_percent")
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
| extend Detail = case(
    MetricName == "cpu_percent", "CPU utilization, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "memory_percent", "Memory utilization, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "storage_percent", "Disk utilization, 6h avg",
    "")
| project Metric = MetricName, Value, Detail
| order by Metric asc

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("active_connections", "max_connections")
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
| extend Detail = case(
    MetricName == "active_connections", "Open DB connections, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "max_connections", "Configured connection limit",
    "")
| project Metric = MetricName, Value, Detail
| order by Metric asc
content.title: PostgreSQL — connection counts, last 6h average — no status color, raw counts (see utilization % tile below for the colored signal)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("active_connections", "max_connections")
| summarize Value = avg(Average) by MetricName
| evaluate pivot(MetricName, avg(Value))
| extend Value = iff(max_connections > 0, round(100.0 * active_connections / max_connections, 1), real(null))
| extend Metric = "connection_utilization_pct"
| project Metric, Value
content.title: PostgreSQL — connection utilization % (active/max), last 6h average

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName == "is_db_alive"
| summarize Value = avg(Average)
| extend Metric = "is_db_alive", Status = iff(Value >= 1, "Alive", "Down")
| project Metric, Status
content.title: PostgreSQL — liveness, last 6h average

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("serverLoad", "usedmemorypercentage")
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
| extend Detail = case(
    MetricName == "serverLoad", "Server load %, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "usedmemorypercentage", "Memory used %, 6h avg",
    "")
| project Metric = MetricName, Value, Detail
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Redis (redis-invoicellm-dev) — utilization, last 6h average

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("connectedclients", "cachehits", "cachemisses")
| summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
| extend Detail = case(
    MetricName == "connectedclients", "Connected clients, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "cachehits", "Cache hits, 6h avg",
    MetricName == "cachemisses", "Cache misses, 6h avg",
    "")
| project Metric = MetricName, Value, Detail
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Redis — client/cache counts, last 6h average — no status color, raw counts (see cache hit ratio % tile below for the colored signal)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName in ("cachehits", "cachemisses")
| summarize Value = avg(Average) by MetricName
| evaluate pivot(MetricName, avg(Value))
| extend Value = iff((cachehits + cachemisses) > 0, round(100.0 * cachehits / (cachehits + cachemisses), 1), real(null))
| extend Metric = "cache_hit_ratio_pct"
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Redis — cache hit ratio % (hits / (hits+misses)), last 6h average — low is bad, inverted from the usual scale

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
| where MetricName == "geoReplicationHealthy"
| summarize Value = avg(Average)
| extend Metric = "geoReplicationHealthy", Status = iff(Value >= 1, "Healthy", "Unhealthy")
| project Metric, Status
content.title: Redis — geo-replication health, last 6h average

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Log_s has "POISON MESSAGE ISOLATED"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Poison messages isolated, last 7 days (same query as the Sev-1 DLQ alert)

content.json: ## API Performance by Feature Area — *real traffic is 0 rows until Gap 292's fix deploys to `ca-invoice-be-dev`, not a broken query*

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AppRoleName != "invoice-be-local-f20-verify"
| extend Area = case(
    Name has "/invoices" or Name has "/email-ingestion", "Ingestion & Extraction",
    Name has "/chat",                                    "Chat",
    Name has "/audit",                                   "Review & Correction",
    Name has "/autopilot" or Name has "/connectors",     "Autopilot & Connectors",
    Name has "/dashboard",                               "Dashboard & Reporting",
    Name has "/trainer",                                 "Trainer",
    Name has "/billing" or Name has "/admin",            "Billing & Admin",
    Name has "/settings/security" or Name has "/auth",   "Auth",
    "Other")
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount),
            P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1)
  by Area
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", strcat(Area, " — Requests"), "Value", tostring(Requests), "Detail", "Total requests, last 30 days"),
    pack("Metric", strcat(Area, " — P95 latency"), "Value", strcat(tostring(P95ms), " ms"), "Detail", "95th percentile latency, last 30 days")
  )
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = tostring(Metrics.Value), Detail = tostring(Metrics.Detail)
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Requests / P95 latency by feature area, last 30 days — no status color (see Error rate tile below for the colored signal)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AppRoleName != "invoice-be-local-f20-verify"
| extend Area = case(
    Name has "/invoices" or Name has "/email-ingestion", "Ingestion & Extraction",
    Name has "/chat",                                    "Chat",
    Name has "/audit",                                   "Review & Correction",
    Name has "/autopilot" or Name has "/connectors",     "Autopilot & Connectors",
    Name has "/dashboard",                               "Dashboard & Reporting",
    Name has "/trainer",                                 "Trainer",
    Name has "/billing" or Name has "/admin",            "Billing & Admin",
    Name has "/settings/security" or Name has "/auth",   "Auth",
    "Other")
| summarize ErrorRatePct = round(100.0 * sumif(ItemCount, Success == false) / sum(ItemCount), 1) by Area
| project Metric = strcat(Area, " — Error rate"), Value = ErrorRatePct
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Error rate by feature area, last 30 days

content.json: ## Recent Alerts — *covers all of Feature 20's alert rules (`alert-rules.bicep`); nothing here creates or edits one*

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ "microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts"
| extend fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime),
         sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| where fired > ago(14d)
| summarize Value = count() by Metric = sev
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Alerts fired per day, by severity — last 14 days

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ "microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts"
| extend fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| where fired > ago(24h)
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = "Alerts fired, last 24h"
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Alerts fired, last 24h

content.json: ## Ops Recommendations — *from `ops_recommendation` (`telemetry.track_ops_recommendation()`), one row per category per nightly run — container health, cost, AI improvement (Gaps 318/319). The grid below shows only the latest run, keyed on the event's own `generated_at` (never `TimeGenerated`, which is ingestion time). `Recommendation` shows the event's own text only when that category's `status` is `recommend`; every other status (`worked`, `no_data`, `insufficient_data`) renders the literal `No recommendation yet` — never inferred from data volume. Expect **0 rows today**: the emitter shipped in Gaps 318/319 but no backend image carrying them has been pushed or run yet, so `ops_recommendation` has never been written to this workspace.*

content.query:
let rows = AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name == "ops_recommendation"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_ts = todatetime(tostring(d.generated_at));
let latest_run = toscalar(rows | summarize max(run_ts));
rows
| where run_ts == latest_run
| project
    Category       = tostring(d["title"]),
    Status         = tostring(d.status),
    Explanation    = tostring(d.explanation),
    Recommendation = iff(isempty(tostring(d.recommendation)), "No recommendation yet", tostring(d.recommendation)),
    Findings       = toint(d.finding_count),
    Red            = toint(d.red_count),
    Yellow         = toint(d.yellow_count),
    Errors         = tostring(d.errors),
    Run            = strcat(tostring(d.run_label), " @ ", tostring(d.generated_at))
| order by Category asc
content.title: Latest recommendation pass, by category (container health / cost / AI improvement) — filtered to the most recent nightly run. No colouring on purpose: worst_severity can be red while recommendation is empty (status != recommend), and colouring that would visually contradict "No recommendation yet".
